2609.25618.title: Reasoning-Preserving Fine-Tuning of Post-RL LLMs with Null-Basis LoRA
2609.25618.paper_summary: Reinforcement learning (RL)-based post-training has become an effective approach for eliciting reasoning capabilities in large language models (LLMs). However, adapting post-RL models to new knowledge domains or behaviors through subsequent supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can severely overwrite these capabilities. Existing approaches mitigate such forgetting through experience replay, specialized initialization, or constrained optimization using gradient projection, but either provide limited preservation or incur substantial training overhead. Our analysis shows that reasoning activations concentrate in low-dimensional subspaces, leaving substantial null-space capacity for adaptation, and that the corresponding approximate null spaces can be reliably estimated from a modest number of examples. Motivated by these observations, we propose Null-Basis Low-Rank Adaptation (NB-LoRA), a parameter-efficient method for adapting post-RL LLMs while preserving their acquired reasoning ability. We formulate reasoning retention as a layer-wise hidden-state preservation constraint and construct a fixed approximate null basis from reasoning activations. LoRA updates are then reparameterized through this basis, enforcing the preservation constraint throughout fine-tuning. Extensive experiments across multiple RL-trained LLMs and diverse downstream tasks show that NB-LoRA matches standard LoRA in adaptation performance, maintains reasoning accuracy near pre-fine-tuning levels, and generalizes this preservation to held-out reasoning benchmarks.
2609.25618.paper_summary_zh: 強化學習 (RL) 基礎的後訓練已成為引發大型語言模型 (LLMs) 推理能力的有效方法。<lb/>然而，通過後續的監督微調 (SFT) 將後 RL 模型適應於新的知識領域或行為，可能會嚴重覆蓋這些能力。<lb/>現有的方法通過經驗重播、專門初始化或使用梯度投影的約束優化來減輕這種遺忘，但要麼提供有限的保留，要麼產生大量的訓練開銷。<lb/>我們的分析顯示，推理激活集中在低維子空間中，留下了相當大的零空間容量以供適應，並且相應的近似零空間可以從少量範例中可靠地估計。<lb/>受這些觀察的啟發，我們提出了零基低秩適應 (NB-LoRA)，這是一種在保留後 RL LLMs 獲得的推理能力的同時進行適應的參數高效方法。<lb/>我們將推理保留公式化為逐層隱藏狀態保留約束，並從推理激活構建一個固定的近似零基。<lb/>然後，LoRA 更新通過這個基重新參數化，在微調過程中強制執行保留約束。<lb/>在多個 RL 訓練的 LLMs 和多樣的下游任務上進行的廣泛實驗顯示，NB-LoRA 在適應性能上與標準 LoRA 相匹配，保持推理準確度接近微調前的水平，並將這種保留推廣到保留的推理基準上。
